annotations.title: Pause or resume many campaigns at once

description: Pause or resume up to 50 campaigns in ONE call, across Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, LinkedIn, Microsoft Advertising, Pinterest, Snapchat, Reddit and X: status pause or resume, campaigns [{platform, campaignId, adAccountId (Google: customerId; TikTok: advertiserId)}]. Each campaign goes through that network's own status tool, and each gets its own result, so one failure never blocks the rest. PAUSING only stops spend and runs at once. RESUMING STARTS REAL AD SPEND: called without confirm it changes nothing and lists each campaign with its name and budget where they could be read; show the user that list, get a yes, then call again with the same campaigns and confirm:true. ChatGPT Ads, Apple Ads, Amazon Ads and AppLovin campaigns are switched one at a time with their own tools.

platform.description: meta, google_ads, tiktok_ads, linkedin, microsoft_ads, pinterest_ads, snapchat_ads, reddit_ads or x_ads

confirm.description: true only after the user approved resuming these campaigns
